items.title: Ranjana Bhagwakar Joins ESAB Corporation as EVP of Enterprise Operations
items.summary: ESAB Corporation announced the appointment of Ranjana (RJ) Bhagwakar as Executive Vice President, Enterprise Operations. Bhagwakar will lead ESAB’s operations organization, responsible for advancing enterprise capabilities, driving the company’s integration process, and strengthening execution across the business to support sustainable growth, margin expansion, and long-term value creation.
